title: Mấy giờ — Asking what time a place opens

segments.script: [EN: Warm up.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: This one.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cái này.] [EN: Go to the market.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Đi Bến Thành.] [EN: Give me the bill.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cho tôi hóa đơn.] [EN: Today.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Hôm nay.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Hôm qua.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Yesterday.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: You call a restaurant about opening time. Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Dạ, nhà hàng nghe.] [EN: She answered] [VI: nhà hàng nghe] [EN: meaning, restaurant speaking.] [EN: To ask what time, say] [VI_F: Mấy giờ?] [VI_F: Mấy] [EN: has a high, rising tone, and means how many. Use it for small counts, not prices.] [VI_F: Giờ] [EN: has a falling tone.] [EN: Ask what time.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Mấy giờ?] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Morning is] [VI_F: Buổi sáng.] [VI_F: Buổi] [EN: has a falling, rising tone.] [EN: Say morning.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Buổi sáng.] [EN: To open is] [VI_F: Mở cửa.] [EN: both syllables falling, rising; relax your lips for both vowels.] [EN: Now ask, what time do you open?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Mấy giờ mở cửa?] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Drill. What time?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Mấy giờ?] [EN: Morning.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Buổi sáng.] [EN: To open.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Mở cửa.] [EN: What time do you open in the morning?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Buổi sáng mấy giờ mở cửa?] [EN: Now reverse.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Mở cửa.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: To open.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Buổi sáng.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Morning.] [EN: And, how many people?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Mấy người?] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_M: Alô, mấy giờ mở cửa?] [EN: He started with] [VI: alô] [EN: hello, on the phone.] [VI_F: Dạ, buổi sáng bảy giờ.] [VI_M: Dạ, cảm ơn.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now you try. Ask what time.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Mấy giờ?] [EN: Ask what time they open.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Mấy giờ mở cửa?] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Tomorrow you ask about distance. The preview word is] [VI: gần] [EN: which means near.]
